<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="necromancy-upgrade-order-talent-tree-ability-bars" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Necromancy </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Upgrade Order, Talent Tree &amp; Ability Bars</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This channel lists the </nowiki><strong><nowiki>general</nowiki></strong><nowiki> natural combat style progression template for new players to follow devised by the RuneScape Discord Luminaries in collaboration with PVME. From levels 1 - 20, where an item is marked P2P, this means it is a members item.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Last Revised: 11 June 2024</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>All bars assume Revo++ is being used</nowiki></em><nowiki>. The bars below are taken from the Youtube video: </nowiki>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rLEbibxK6OI <nowiki>Necromancy revolution bars</nowiki>]<nowiki>. Below we use the </nowiki><em><nowiki>AoE Healing</nowiki></em><nowiki> bars as our main AoE bar whilst you learn combat in RuneScape. It is worth noting that Necromancy ability bars can change upon every new ability unlock. Therefore, for more granular information on how to set up your ability bars at each ability unlock, check out the linked video above.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="talent-tree-unlocks"><ins><nowiki>Talent Tree Unlocks</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/xoUfjyZr9M.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
</nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Talents <nowiki>Talents</nowiki>]<nowiki> allow the player to unlock and upgrade Necromancy abilities, incantations, and passive effects. Talents can be unlocked with talent points, which can be acquired by gaining experience in combat using necromancy as a combat style. Unlocking higher tiers requires a combination of Necromancy levels, an amount of souls contributed to the Well of Souls through rituals, at least one talent from the previous tier, as well as the completion of quests and are managed at the Well of Souls at the ritual site in the City of Um.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>We recommend you upgrade your talent tree in the following order:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/mBjK1tXPqG.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
⬥ Unlock </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809149690916945.png?v=1" alt="spectralscythe2" title="spectralscythe2" kind="icon" /><nowiki> as soon as possible over any unbought upgrades when you hit level 70</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="levels-1-20"><ins><nowiki>Levels 1 - 20</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>You must craft weapons and armour at least once to be able to equip them (excluding the tier 10 set)</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="gear"><nowiki>Gear:</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ 1 ‎ ‎</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Death guard (tier 10) &amp; Skull lantern (tier 10)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Free from the quest </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Necromancy!/Quick_guide <nowiki>Necromancy!</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ 20 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Death guard (tier 20) &amp; Skull lantern (tier 20)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Requires completion of the quest </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Kili_Row/Quick_guide <nowiki>Kili Row</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Bought from </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Buried_Bargains <nowiki>Buried Bargains</nowiki>]<nowiki> after completion of the quest </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Necromancy!/Quick_guide <nowiki>Necromancy!</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ 20 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1" alt="defence" title="defence" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Deathwarden robe armour (tier 20)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Requires completion of the quest </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Kili_Row/Quick_guide <nowiki>Kili Row</nowiki>]</p>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Deathstorm_drape <nowiki>Deathstorm drape</nowiki>]<nowiki> - Best in Slot cape for F2P</nowiki></p>

</nowiki>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The boots can be upgraded at lvl 20, 40, 50 and 60 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1" alt="defence" title="defence" kind="icon" /><nowiki> respectively.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="rituals"><nowiki>Rituals</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>To unlock </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Talents <nowiki>Talents</nowiki>]<nowiki> in tier 2 of the Talent Tree at level 20, the player will need 50 souls. To maximise souls per ritual, you can use a </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Fragile_memento <nowiki>Fragile memento</nowiki>]<nowiki> performing </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Lesser_communion <nowiki>Lesser communication</nowiki>]<nowiki> rituals. These are 8 souls per ritual before accounting for multiply glyphs.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">

<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>1 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> When you begin, you will only have access to </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1" alt="necrobasic" title="necrobasic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> - this ability does not need to go onto your action bar if you have it set to automatically be used when no other abilities are available (this is the default setting).</nowiki></p>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ At level 8 ‎ ‎</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> add </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1" alt="fingerofdeath" title="fingerofdeath" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ At level 13 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> add </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1" alt="touchofdeath" title="touchofdeath" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>

<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ At level 20 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> you will unlock the ability to command your skeleton conjure using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1" alt="commandskeleton" title="commandskeleton" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if you have unlocked it at the talent tree. This ability overrides </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434516658651147.png?v=1" alt="conjureskeleton" title="conjureskeleton" kind="icon" /><nowiki> whilst your skeleton is summoned. If you have unlocked the command, swap around </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1" alt="touchofdeath" title="touchofdeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434516658651147.png?v=1" alt="conjureskeleton" title="conjureskeleton" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>

</nowiki>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>To unlock </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Talents <nowiki>Talents</nowiki>]<nowiki> in tiers 4 and 5 of the Talent Tree at levels 60 and 70 respectively, the player will need 2,000 souls for tier 4 and 4,500 souls for tier 5. To maximise souls per ritual, wait until 60 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to begin performing rituals again. You can use a </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Spirit_memento <nowiki>Spirit memento</nowiki>]<nowiki> performing </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Greater_communion <nowiki>Greater communication</nowiki>]<nowiki> rituals. These are 24 souls per ritual before accounting for multiply glyphs.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="frequently-asked-questions"><ins><nowiki>Frequently asked questions</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>⬥ Why are there only Dual Wield weapons listed here?</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Necromancy </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> currently only has Dual Wield weapons. This guide will be updated should this change in the future.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>⬥ What are Special Attacks </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and how do I use them?</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Certain weapons e.g. </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809262194294864.png?v=1" alt="deathguard70" title="deathguard70" kind="icon" /><nowiki> have special attacks - these are powerful abilities that you have to activate manually. Therefore, place </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> outside your revolution bar (the abilities with gold trim around them) if your weapon has one. You can find the ability in your Constitution </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1" alt="constitution" title="constitution" kind="icon" /><nowiki> abilities.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Can I just train slayer?</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You certainly can if you want some variety. It is, however, slower to train at lower combat levels.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>⬥ Why are weapons upgrades more important than armour upgrades? / Why is power armour recommended over tank armour?</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Frankly put: You gain more from hitting harder than from getting hit less. A higher tier weapon lets you hit harder by increasing hit chance and damage bonus. Power armour increases damage bonus too. This lets you hit harder and kill more monsters, which means more xp gained per hour.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
      
    </nowiki>
